name: Ryman Healthcare
h1: Disciplined growth, with every initiative in view
lede: Ryman is focused on care-centred living, recurring earnings and a $150m cash-flow improvement target by FY29. Airtable gives operations, development and finance teams one connected view of the work behind those goals.
why_h2: A refreshed strategy with clear targets to track
why_p: A new capital management framework, a cash-flow programme and an active build pipeline all depend on visibility across many workstreams.

signals.title: Refreshed strategy and capital management framework
signals.body: Ryman set out a refreshed strategy focused on recurring earnings from its existing portfolio, with a path to sustainable dividends in FY28.
signals.angle: Strategy refreshes land faster when every initiative, owner and milestone sits in one place.

signals.title: First positive free cash flow in over a decade
signals.body: FY26 free cash flow was $188m, revenue rose 10% to $849m and gearing was 27.8%.
signals.angle: Holding these gains means keeping process and cost visibility high across villages.

signals.title: $150m cash-flow improvement target, $47m delivered
signals.body: FY27 guidance includes capex of $150m to $180m and 157 to 168 units and beds, with $47m of the FY29 cash-flow target already delivered and the land divestment target raised to about $250m.
signals.angle: Track each efficiency initiative, build and divestment against target in one connected view.

signals.title: NZ$150m retail bond offer closes
signals.body: Ryman allocated NZ$150m of six-year secured bonds after demand of about three times the offer size, with proceeds to repay bank debt and refinance existing bonds.
signals.angle: Lender and investor reporting is easier with connected, current programme data.
